She can’t point to the sore tooth.  
She can’t tell me what hurts.  
And breath chews don’t magically fix dirty teeth.

I thought she’d reject this like every other dental thing.

But it works like I now have a dental assistant.

It calms her, controls her, like a dog collar works on dogs.

Now I brush her teeth every day without the usual fight.
